summary: 01/02/2021: Assailants aboard motorcycles opened fire on the village of Tchombangou, Tillaberi region, Niger. Seventy-three people were killed in the attack and thirteen were injured. This was one of two related incidents targeting villages in the area on this date. The Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (ISGS) claimed responsibility for the attack stated it was "avenging the deaths of Muslims killed at the hands of militias" and claimed the targets of the attack were members of government-affiliated militias. Authorities suspected the attack was conducted in retaliation for the earlier killing of two fighters by villagers.
